# Sulca's Carpets

> Family- and veteran-owned flooring showroom in Elk Grove, California, serving Elk Grove and the Sacramento area since 2003. Flooring sales and installation plus kitchen and bath remodeling. Free in-home estimates.

## Contact
- Address: 9766 Waterman Rd Ste K, Elk Grove, CA 95624
- Phone: (916) 686-1704
- Email: CUSTOMFLOORS@SULCASCARPETS.COM
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
- Service area: Elk Grove and Sacramento, CA

## Services
- Carpet sales and installation
- Hardwood installation, refinishing and staining
- Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) and laminate
- Tile and natural stone
- Area rugs
- Countertops
- Cabinets
- Crown molding and trim
- Paint and stain (floors and interiors)
- Kitchen remodeling and bathroom remodeling
- Floor repair (worn or damaged floors)
